objective: D — the Telegram bot's post flow, end to end, on Cloudflare staging
railway: still not used anywhere in this path
question_answered: Does a prepared post actually reach the channel from the bot's own menu, with the real Telegram rights, without inventing data?

defects_found_by_running_it.symptom: `/post` refused with CHANNEL_UNVERIFIED for a chat where the bot is an administrator
defects_found_by_running_it.root_cause: `blockedReason()` asked `getChatMember(chatId, "@me")`; Telegram answers 400 `invalid user_id specified` for a non-numeric user id, so every verification failed
defects_found_by_running_it.fix: resolve the bot's own numeric id with `getMe().id`, then decide with `botCanPostIn(chatType, member)`: a channel needs `canPostMessages`; a restricted group member needs `canSendMessages`; every other member is decided by live membership. A stored `can_post=false` no longer vetoes a live-confirmed chat — only `status !== "ACTIVE"` does
defects_found_by_running_it.pinned_by: telegramPostService.test.ts (bot's own id is asked of getChatMember; supergroup admin without can_post_messages is publishable; memberStatus=left is CHANNEL_UNVERIFIED), telegramApi.test.ts (vocabulary)

defects_found_by_running_it.symptom: A blocked preview left the user with an EMPTY keyboard: a code and no way out
defects_found_by_running_it.root_cause: the refusal branch built an either/or keyboard, and with a channel bound but unverified both rows could come out empty
defects_found_by_running_it.fix: the blocked preview always carries `menu:channel` + `menu:home`, plus `menu:checklist` when checklist gaps exist; the publish `unavailable` outcome attaches the same fixes
defects_found_by_running_it.pinned_by: telegramBot.test.ts (blocked preview offers the fix for ITS cause; preview missing checklist fields points at the checklist)

defects_found_by_running_it.symptom: A publish button was offered on a bias card whose bias lines all read 'not recorded'
defects_found_by_running_it.root_cause: nothing connected the template's checklist requirement to the render's missing-field list
defects_found_by_running_it.fix: `PreviewResult.incompleteData` = the template requires a checklist AND at least one checklist field was NEVER ANSWERED (`UNREVIEWED`). A field answered `UNKNOWN` is an answer and does not block — a day with no SMT is legitimate. The bot offers publish only when `blockedReason === null && !incompleteData`

defects_found_by_running_it.symptom: Re-running `/post` after filing the checklist re-showed the OLD draft (all fields 'not recorded') with a publish button on it
defects_found_by_running_it.root_cause: the dedupe key that stops a re-delivered update from double-posting also matched a second DELIBERATE request; the stored bytes were returned unchanged
defects_found_by_running_it.fix: a duplicate whose rendered bytes differ and whose row is still an unapproved DRAFT is revised in place (`revisePost`, which clears the approval in the same write); an APPROVED or PUBLISHED row keeps the bytes the user signed off on
defects_found_by_running_it.pinned_by: telegramPostService.test.ts (a duplicate key whose bytes changed refreshes an unapproved draft; identical bytes stay a reuse, and an APPROVED row is never rewritten)

defects_found_by_running_it.symptom: `/analyze` and agent requests surfaced a provider failure as a generic error
defects_found_by_running_it.fix: `classifyProviderFailure()` reads the provider's own `err.code`/`err.status` and the copy splits 429 (rate limited), 503 (busy) and timeout into three sentences that say what to do

live_test.recorder_rule: read methods (getMe/getChat/getChatMember) are FORWARDED to api.telegram.org verbatim; every write is answered locally and never forwarded, so no message can reach the real channel from this run — the owner's rule is that a real post needs an explicit approval in the flow

the row ended PUBLISHED with the channel's message id; a second tap answered 'already published' and sent nothing

reported_not_hidden: The publish in the live run was recorded, not delivered: a real post to -1003245304814 needs the owner's explicit approval in the flow.
The bias card still prints a footnote counting NON-checklist fields the template names but no data supplies (symbol/timeframe/…); those are not part of the completeness gate.
Screenshot OCR stays refused by design on the Worker (IMAGE_NOT_ANONYMIZED, no anonymizer in workerd).
